name: taskcode-plugin
description: TaskCode: metodologia de tareas/sprints + Git-Flow + revision por pares de agentes, como plugin de Claude Code.

scripts.test: npm run limpiar:test && npm run build && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=./dist/test/reporter/progreso.js --test-reporter-destination=stderr "dist/test/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test:rapido: npm run limpiar:test && npm run build && node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=./dist/test/reporter/progreso.js --test-reporter-destination=stderr "dist/test/core/**/*.test.js" "dist/test/cli/**/*.test.js"
